## HD-S19-002 — PURPOSE AND CONTINUITY MODEL

## PURPOSE AND CONTINUITY MODEL

This file is the active campaign continuity spine through Session 18, carrying play forward from **Monday, June 5, 2051 — approximately 19:10**. It preserves older material when that material still explains present knowledge, reactions, obligations, relationships to the world, active projects, hidden GM facts, or likely future consequences. It is not a session transcript and it is not a general campaign-rules file.

Newer established facts supersede older current-state snapshots. Older facts are removed only when they are genuinely superseded or when their surviving effect is represented elsewhere in this file or in a routed detail file. Omission from a newer short header is not by itself evidence that an older fact stopped being true.

## HD-S19-004 — EXACT CURRENT STATE <FALSE>

# EXACT CURRENT STATE <FALSE>

**Monday, June 5, 2051 — approximately 19:10.**

**Location:** Taetzel, 16801 Taetzel St. / 92nd St., Redmond, WA, UCAS.

Singer and Glaze are home after Glaze's first self-directed Seattle outing in which she chose the destinations, handled routine arrangements, and drove the Westwind herself under autonav assistance. The evening then became a concentrated but voluntary computer/Matrix-learning session. Glaze has stopped for the night; Singer joins her in bed. There is **no immediate attack or emergency in progress**.

The biggest practical change is environmental: Singer has completed the dioxane-focused remediation he intended to perform now. The old roughly 6,000 m3 contaminated-water inventory has been largely emptied through magical batch treatment and clean discharge; residual building wastewater, black water, sludge, wash water and non-dioxane contaminants have been gathered back into the tank/containment system. Singer also treated surrounding seepage/soil out to roughly 13 m with **Clean Earth** where the spell could safely transform contaminants, while metallic/nontransformable material was mobilized toward the tank space and return-pump sumps. Rainwater overflow is now routed into the large tank and will refill it at the actual rainfall rate. Singer has requested **EPA Superfund post-remediation testing for August** through Project Manager Perfecto Polymers.

Singer left Cole a simple physical note for the next work period: **“Stop incoming water at full tank, EPA in a month or two.”**

Singer is no longer persistently cold in the way Glaze has known since the cave. He explained that his internal factories are no longer replacing nanites. Treat this as a major recovery milestone from the arrival injuries, not proof that every possible injury/recovery issue is permanently resolved.

The household Red-7 host is active. Aztechnology settlement implementation has moved from negotiation into delegated logistics. Glaze has an active beginner computer-training path and intends to use the stolen/modified Fuchi training utility routinely, especially once her custom 'trodes arrive.

## HD-S19-005 — REALITY / SINGER'S ORIGIN — CURRENT<FALSE> WORLD FACT

# REALITY / SINGER'S ORIGIN — CURRENT<FALSE> WORLD FACT

Singer comes from a genuine **2064 parallel history**, not ordinary time travel. GM truth: the campaign reality is a critically branched parallel world. The crossing is not intended as a solvable riddle, and Singer does not know the full explanation.

A major divergence Singer has already verified is that in his history **Schwartzkopf manifested at Furth im Wald / Schwarzkoppe Mountain on May 21, 2051 and proclaimed sovereignty**. Contemporary records in this reality show no such event. Singer therefore treats his memories as professional/personal knowledge and comparison material, not as guaranteed prophecy about this world's future.

Singer arrived beneath **Mt. Baker / Kulshan** after escaping a lethal attack in 2064, catastrophically injured, overloaded/blind, with only his packed military rucksack and debris from the medical tank around him. His internal repair systems stabilized him over time. He found Glaze sleeping in a sealed natural cavity, not a constructed treasure lair. Singer Cleansed the hostile background count to zero and later helped open the cave toward the surface.

Taetzel has special weight for Singer because a different Taetzel existed in his parallel history as a family/home/business stronghold. That history does not transfer into this reality, but it explains why this building can produce unusually strong recognition, memory collision, and investment. His remembered Taetzel included clinics, shops, publishing/printing, rented security operations, weapon shops/armory, and a history of gang/corporate violence around his family. None of those old tenants, arrangements, gang settlements, or family events automatically exist here.

Singer remembers personally opening a roughly three-meter wound in Perianwyr with a polearm in his own history. That did not happen in this reality; the current Taetzel roof instead records a fight in which Perianwyr took anti-vehicle missile fire. Singer's memory of Perianwyr and the current world's evidence are therefore related only through parallel-history recognition, not a shared exact past.

Singer's severe May 30 collapse on the 28th floor came from perfect autobiographical memory colliding with a place strongly resembling his lost family home soon after catastrophic family loss. By June 1 he is outwardly functioning and astrally stable under Masking. The event remains part of his relationship to Taetzel but should not be treated as a generic recurrent fragility or as something automatically cured.

## HD-S19-007 — Modern-world working knowledge

## Modern-world working knowledge

Glaze has now accumulated direct working experience with electricity, batteries, communications, computation, software/pilots/smart frames, Matrix basics, identity/verification, credsticks, media/advertising/propaganda, universities, magical scholarship, satellites/logistics/population scale, policing/security, corporate sovereignty, hotels/building systems, transport, restaurants/service culture, public crowds, nightlife, clothing/fashion signaling, SIN/SINless exclusion, organlegging, common metatype prejudice, libraries, Seattle geography around familiar districts, modern property ownership, and the existence of modern militarized corporate force.

She increasingly handles routine purchases, questions, directions, short negotiations and public interaction herself rather than needing Singer to mediate ordinary modern life. Her cultural displacement concerns missing modern facts and changed assumptions; it is not social helplessness.

By June 5 this has advanced materially. Glaze independently ran several hours of Taetzel morning activity while Singer slept, dealt directly with Cole, answered vendor/medical-project questions herself, chose and conducted a Seattle outing, drove the Westwind herself under autonav assistance, paid/admitted/ordered/bargained without Singer as intermediary, and returned home without needing him to take over. She remains a novice driver, not an expert.

Her computer/Matrix understanding also advanced from broad concepts to direct practice. She now understands UMS iconography, host/file/search metaphors, basic legal operations, Locate File/Access Node logic, downloads, files vs local copies, Null Operations/time pressure, security tally/alerts conceptually, Scramble as destructive file protection, the distinction between public directory data and infrastructure routing truth, legitimate-user access versus intrusion, the role of Computer skill, cyberterminal/deck persona functions, Masking, and why Singer's Matrix capability is far outside normal expert scale. She explicitly chose **legal ordinary competence first** rather than immediately becoming a decker.

On June 1 she also gained direct ordinary experience with ferry travel, a routine Salish-Shidhe Council border crossing, rural/island road travel, and using her pocket secretary to set alarms/calendar entries herself. These are small competence gains, not new campaign objectives.

The Aztechnology incident adds a concrete modern lesson: a AAA corporation can deploy military aircraft, armored vehicles, drones, electronic warfare, magical personnel, public-relations containment, legal/negotiating teams, and information suppression around one incident. Glaze also directly negotiated against such an institution and successfully treated its need for ambiguity/reputation control as leverage. This should influence her understanding of modern political power more than abstract descriptions of megacorporations did.

## HD-S19-010 — Horrors / future survival — active residue, not closed history

## Horrors / future survival — active residue, not closed history

The June 1 Horror discussion remains **top-of-mind material for both characters** even though they chose to stop the conversation before the Aztechnology incident.

Singer's position as expressed to Glaze:

- Horrors do not require spectacular evil; ordinary moral failure can provide weakness or entry.
- Alachia must have found some protection against immediate failure. The possibility that her thorned condition was a ward, ritual, embodied defense, or price is **speculation only**, not established canon.
- Singer describes **Mother Earth** as another kind of barrier, analogous to the protection of Glaze's old cave: opaque/impassable to Horrors rather than simply a fortification that can be battered down normally.
- A future Horror incursion cannot safely be answered only by hiding. Singer fears Horrors could manipulate people into using civilization's own weapons—including nuclear weapons—to break open paths if direct defenses remain inadequate.
- His long-term conclusion is that people eventually have to become capable of fighting Horrors directly, or a future cycle may become terminal rather than merely another Scourge survived by shelters.

Glaze has firsthand ancient Horror/Scourge context that makes this more than Singer telling frightening folklore. At the same time, neither character has converted the discussion into an immediate campaign mission. Singer explicitly stopped the negative spiral and noted that Glaze has centuries and he hopes to have at least two or three himself. Glaze honored the stop.

This concern should remain available to color their interpretation of ancient politics, magical education, Alachia, wards, old dragon behavior, and future planning without making every modern problem secretly a Horror plot.

## HD-S19-011 — Magical education / Awakened children

## Magical education / Awakened children

Singer has asked Glaze to pay attention to **Awakened children**, especially in an E-zone where children manifesting magic may have little safe training and can be exploited, burn out, or simply die from mistakes. He contrasted the current world with his mentor's claim that in an older society nearly every magically active child was trained very young, with the elves in the Blood Wood particularly systematic.

Glaze has already noticed multiple magically active auras in Seattle crowds and now has enough modern context to understand why access to training is socially uneven. This is a standing moral/educational concern, not an instruction to turn every child into a plot hook.

# TAETZEL — CURRENT<FALSE> OPERATIONAL STATE

## HD-S19-018 — Building / ownership / access

## Building / ownership / access

Taetzel is a 28-story Festung-style structure plus subfloor, roughly **70m x 70m** in footprint. The first floor is double-height. Floors 1–20 have the heavy opaque fortress shell; floors 21–28 are wrapped in continuous mirrored heavy ballistic glass. The central spine carries cargo, personnel and executive elevators, with cargo service reaching the subfloor.

**BMH owns the building.** The 28th floor is Singer and Glaze's private residence. Workers, tenants, shop personnel, contractors, old associates, corporate representatives and visitors do not gain routine access merely because they have business elsewhere in the building.

Riku's motorcycle business remains on the first floor with Singer/BMH's explicit permission. The shop is Yakuza-sponsored/protected, but Riku is not landlord, property manager, security chief, or automatic spokesman for the organization behind the shop. His people stay on the first floor unless invited higher. One north loading/service bay is used by the shop; Singer uses the other as vehicle space.

Floors 2–20 remain largely open, stripped industrial plates; electrical floors 6/9/12/15/18 contain major 600V infrastructure. Floors 21–27 are mostly open mirrored plates. The 23rd-floor paper/toilet-paper cache and the better-finished/soundproofed 27th floor remain established details if relevant. Dragon-scale architectural conversion of an upper floor is still only a possible future project.

## HD-S19-022 — Potable water / wastewater / contamination

## Potable water / wastewater / contamination

The upper residential potable-water system remains distinct from the subfloor waste/remediation system. The earlier roof rainwater-collection restriction was a debris/recharge problem, not dioxane entering household potable water.

The old subfloor state of roughly **6,000 m3** polluted-water capacity carrying about **2,500 kg of 1,4-dioxane** is now superseded as an active bulk-water condition. Across June 4 Singer first treated **1,300 m3** and remixed it into the tank, then later spent additional hours treating tank water until the falling contaminant concentration made direct tank casting inefficient. He changed to batch treatment through the discharge pan: fill, magically clean, discharge. By late evening most of the old tank volume had been removed as clean discharge.

Singer then opened the whole wastewater/discharge system, brute-forced the problem valve Cole had refused to open under uncertain pressure, and used **Fix** to repair the fresh mechanical damage and restore useful operation. By 22:00 June 4 he had driven remaining water from building discharge/waste lines back to the tank, purged waste sludge, flushed toilets/sinks/plumbing through the system, and used **Clean Earth** on surrounding seepage/pollution out to roughly **13 m**. Contaminants the spell could safely transform were rendered harmless; metallic or otherwise nontransformable material was physically brought toward the tank-space/return-sump area instead. Singer used a pressure washer to sweep mobilized residue toward the return-pump sumps.

The remaining tank contents are therefore **black water, ordinary sewage/wash water, rainwater as it arrives, and residual non-dioxane/nontransformable contaminants**, not the former concentrated dioxane inventory. Do not silently re-create the old 2,500 kg dioxane state. Rainwater overflow now feeds the large tank; stop incoming water when the tank reaches full.

Singer requested **EPA Superfund post-remediation testing for August** through Project Manager Perfecto Polymers. This external verification is still pending and should be allowed to test the result rather than assuming Singer's own assessment is the final regulatory proof.

**Raymond Cole** remains the paid local worker for conventional pumps, valves, seals, recirculation and containment. He is not the magical remediation lead or project designer.

Cole's role remains practical and bounded. Do not turn him into a therapist, corporate representative, magical witness, or independent environmental authority.

## HD-S19-027 — TAETZEL / REDMOND — SOCIAL POSITION AND NEIGHBORHOOD REPUTATION

# TAETZEL / REDMOND — SOCIAL POSITION AND NEIGHBORHOOD REPUTATION

This section is deliberately substantial. Taetzel's social position is not a flavor note; it changes how ordinary locals, gangs, contractors, snoops and businesses plausibly approach the property.

## HD-S19-028 — Redmond local baseline

## Redmond local baseline

Taetzel sits in an inhabited **E-rated Redmond slum**, not an empty ruin field. The surrounding area is poor, institutionally neglected and heavily informal, but still full of residents, patched apartments, shops, stalls, workshops, salvage, reused corporate infrastructure, vehicles, deliveries, electronics, small businesses, gangs, families and people trying to make a living.

Routine Lone Star protection is effectively absent for many SINless residents. Local security is therefore produced through neighbors, gangs, businesses, reputation, private arrangements and the ability to make consequences believable. Normal municipal assumptions—especially dependable police presence and routine city trash service—should not overwrite the established E-zone reality.

This matters because reputation is functional infrastructure. People do not need a formal dossier to decide whether to test Taetzel, work there, sell to it, avoid it, gossip about it, or ask it for help.

## HD-S19-029 — Before Singer/Glaze: "the dragon-fight building"

## Before Singer/Glaze: "the dragon-fight building"

Taetzel was already locally notorious before BMH occupation. Six months earlier, street people saw unmarked vans and several dozen workers, then squads of toughs brutally clearing several surrounding blocks. The building then became the site of a major fight involving **a dragon and anti-vehicle missiles**. The roof still carries evidence.

The neighborhood does not need the names Perianwyr, Kyle Morgan or Dragon Knights. The stable local fact is simpler: **this is the building where people fought a dragon with missile launchers.** It is recent local history, not an old legend.

When Singer and Glaze moved in, they were therefore not anonymous newcomers taking over a generic empty office tower. They visibly reoccupied a place that locals already associated with extreme violence and dangerous owners.

## HD-S19-030 — Neighborhood reputation — occupation through Aztechnology

## Neighborhood reputation — occupation through Aztechnology

During the first days of occupation, Singer and Glaze established a consistent local pattern: extremely capable, private and alert, but **not predatory**. They repaired and occupied Taetzel rather than claiming territory; allowed Riku's protected motorcycle shop to remain; detected snoops without casually killing them; hired and paid local workers for bounded jobs; protected workers from the chemical hazard; and interacted directly enough that Glaze was visibly an independent authority rather than a passive companion. Marcus Bell's group also tested the property over old debts and left with the message that the new occupants were fixing their own problems, not making a territorial play. By May 31 the practical local read was **dangerous, competent, predictable, pays what is promised, wants privacy, and does not look for excuses to hurt weaker people**.

The June 1 Aztechnology assault changed the **scale**, not the moral direction, of that reputation. Nearby people do not need the technical truth of the fight: a AAA megacorporation brought military force to Taetzel, failed to simply take the property, later recovered its people and equipment under controlled conditions, and negotiated while Singer and Glaze remained in possession. Rumor will distort methods and casualties, but the visible outcome is hard to miss: **Taetzel stood its ground against a AAA corporation and was still there afterward.**

That should push local behavior toward **serious respect, wariness and curiosity**, with fewer casual tests and more care around Taetzel's boundaries. The earlier non-predatory pattern matters more now because locals have greater reason to fear what Singer and Glaze *could* do while also having evidence that they do not automatically use that capacity against neighbors, workers, retreating snoops or helpless wounded. Aztechnology's information suppression may obscure public attribution, but it cannot erase neighborhood memory of what people saw and heard. Do not convert this into worship, fealty, a protection racket or endless challengers.

1. **Direct repair/compensation:** Aztechnology repairs damage it caused to Taetzel and the surrounding neighborhood and covers reasonable direct losses/disruption.
2. **Food/homeless shelter:** a real shelter within useful walking distance with actual service capacity, not a one-time publicity distribution.
3. **Water infrastructure:** a potable-water tanker truck, large stainless-steel storage tanks, pumps, filtration and supporting infrastructure sufficient to make them functional.
4. **Medical clinic:** a clinic capable of supporting **eight physicians**, with proper diagnostic/treatment equipment.
5. **Operating support:** the clinic receives **five years** of meaningful operating support so it does not become an empty photographed shell.
6. **PR freedom:** Aztechnology may attach its name, photograph the projects and construct whatever public explanation it prefers. If the agreement is honored, Singer/Glaze will not publicly contradict the story merely to embarrass the corporation.
7. **No Corporate Court escalation:** if Aztechnology performs, Singer/Glaze do not pursue Corporate Court action arising from this incident.
8. **No deliberate evidence dump:** if Aztechnology performs, Singer/Glaze do not deliberately release their security evidence as a public centerpiece.
9. **Noninterference:** no retaliation or manufactured investigations aimed at Taetzel, its owners, tenants, employees, contractors or nearby people; no harassment through subsidiaries; no continuing intelligence action designed to recover what Reynaldo lost or probe the household.
10. **No astral scouting/investigation:** no projecting personnel, spirits, astral reconnaissance, magical "security assessment" used as a synonym for investigation, or astral tracking initiated from material obtained in the incident.
11. **Reciprocal intelligence restraint:** absent another intrusion, Singer/Glaze have no interest in running an intelligence campaign against Aztechnology.
12. **Reynaldo-history restraint:** if Aztechnology observes the settlement/intelligence restrictions, Singer will avoid investigating why Reynaldo was still alive despite the old public history around Mercurial. Singer explicitly does not want an ongoing intelligence war with a AAA corporation.

These remain **terms, not completed infrastructure**. Do not silently place a finished shelter, clinic, tanker system, repaired neighborhood or five years of funding into the world before performance is established.

Singer/Glaze have offered substantial silence and restraint **in return for performance**, not unconditional forgiveness. A later violation of the noninterference terms would change the posture and should be handled as a new fact rather than pretending the settlement never existed.

Aztechnology has now answered that request. Baltasar's office committed to a preliminary implementation plan, a factual chronology/findings/corrective-action/accounting package rather than distributing the complete internal incident review, and recurring coordination. The June 5 meeting then converted the plan into a working logistics model: water first, clinic operator/staffing before site commitment, shelter separate, damage assessment from public property, and no BMH property access without arrangement.

**Lucía Herrera** now holds routine facilities implementation/scheduling authority; **Mateo Serrano** remains the legal route; **Baltasar** remains copied on major deviations, delays or politically sensitive issues. Singer explicitly invited delegation of routine scheduling. The household accepts contact at any time but may not answer immediately. Water drivers should notify with as much lead time as practical and abort/turn around rather than create a security escalation if harassed.

## HD-SUPPORT-001 — Campaign Introduction — The Cave

# Campaign Introduction — The Cave

## HD-SUPPORT-002 — Scope

## Scope

This file begins **after Singer has arrived in the cave**. The medical facility attack, escape, metaplanar transit, and the exact mechanics of how he crossed into this world remain in their fuller source material and are not duplicated here.

This is an introduction/state file, not an interaction log. Detailed exchanges, relationship development, dialogue, disclosures, and changing opinions between Singer and Glaze belong in a separate **Player Interactions** file.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-003 — Opening State

## Opening State

Singer arrives hard on cold stone inside a sealed mountain cavity with no visible entrance, path, or explanation for why he is there.

He is badly injured but stabilized rather than actively dying. He has suffered multiple distinct wounds from the attack before transit: ballistic trauma, a monofilament cut, blast damage, electrical injury, scalp injury, and associated blood loss. His medical augmentations and nanite systems are working aggressively to preserve him.

He is initially unconscious or only intermittently conscious. His visual systems are badly overloaded and require patient, one-system-at-a-time resets before usable sight can return. Other senses remain available and become important while vision is unavailable.

Singer is wearing only white boxer briefs and still possesses the stuffed, cinched military-style rucksack he carried through the transit. Debris from the medical environment arrived with him, including fragments of tank glass, torn tubing, bandage material, and residue from the recovery tank.

The cave air is cold, mineral, old, and faintly musty. Water moves slowly through the stone. Singer's arrival adds blood, antiseptic residue, scorched electrical odors, chemical contamination, and medical debris to an otherwise ancient space.

Singer does **not** know where he is, how far he has traveled, or that he is no longer in the version of the world he remembers.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-004 — The Cave

## The Cave

The chamber is beneath the Mt. Baker region, inside an ancient sealed cavity near Lincoln Peak.

It is not a throne room, treasure hall, or constructed fortress. It is closer to an enormous natural burrow. The entrance has been buried by geologic change, ice movement, scree, and collapse.

The cavity is extremely cramped for what occupies it. Glaze fills it almost completely in full dragon form, coiled nose to tail with her wings folded flat and doubled back against the stone. The surrounding rock bears old marks from the slow movement of a sleeping creature with building-scale mass.

The surrounding astral environment carries a **Background Count of 4**. It is savage, uneven, and old, pooled most heavily around the buried entrance and strongly associated with Glaze's long presence. It is not an ordinary ward, lodge, or recent magical contamination.

Natural earth and the dense local astral conditions make astral travel through the surrounding stone difficult. Small weaknesses and gaps exist, but the cave is substantially enclosed both physically and astrally.

Outside is high mountain terrain: snow, glaciers, broken ridges, forested distances, and the broader Pacific Northwest landscape.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-005 — Glaze at the Opening

## Glaze at the Opening

Glaze is a **Great Western Fire Dragon** and a relic of an age so old that much of her personal history predates reliable surviving records.

She begins the scene asleep in full dragon form.

She was already drifting toward wakefulness before Singer arrived. The world's mana had risen enough that continued sleep was becoming less attractive. Her initial state is sleepy, curious, patient, somewhat hungry, and bored rather than alarmed or hostile.

Singer's arrival is extraordinary not because a wounded metahuman is physically dangerous to her, but because a living being has appeared inside a sealed chamber through a route that should not exist.

Glaze is dual-natured and does not need to open her physical eyes before the astral disturbance becomes meaningful to her.

Her full dragon body is approximately thirty meters long before the tail, with roughly fifty tons of mass. Her hide is obsidian-black with sapphire veining, swept black horns, faceted amber eyes, and a pale blue-white luminosity at the throat. Her scale and mass must be treated as materially real in the environment.

Glaze does not know the modern world. She does not begin with knowledge of current nations, technology, institutions, politics, recent history, or modern culture. Her intelligence and skill allow strong inference, but do not provide facts she has not observed, remembered, inferred, or been taught.

Her preferred communication is telepathy. In full dragon form she should not casually use metahuman spoken languages; her physical vocal apparatus is draconic.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-006 — Singer at the Opening

## Singer at the Opening

Singer should enter the campaign as displaced rather than dominant.

Although he possesses extreme accumulated competence, advanced augmentations, powerful magic, broad technical skill, and deep experience, none of those automatically solve his immediate situation. He begins injured, socially isolated, without a known support network, and uncertain whether information from his remembered world is valid here.

Narration may freely describe visible injury, blood, breathing, tank residue, exhaustion, obvious medical distress, his rucksack, and the cave around him.

Do **not** select Singer's actions, private thoughts, tactical decisions, spell choices, Matrix actions, hidden systems, memories, or use of special capabilities. Those enter play when the player provides them.

Singer's normal astral presentation is deeply masked. Unless he deliberately allows otherwise or masking is successfully penetrated, he presents an intentionally ordinary version of himself rather than revealing his extensive magical, biological, cybernetic, molecular, or form-changing alterations.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-007 — Initial Medical Situation

## Initial Medical Situation

Singer's body is being kept alive by multiple layers of internal support.

His Guardian Angel and other medical systems can enter an emergency aid mode, display diagnostic information on the body, issue instructions through available interfaces, and attempt to recruit outside assistance. His nanite and biological repair systems can stabilize and close damage, but serious destruction to those systems may require time to rebuild.

Recovery should remain physical and costly rather than becoming instant simply because Singer is highly augmented.

At the beginning of the cave sequence, Singer has severe Physical injury and Deadly Stun. Stun recovery occurs on the hourly scale under SR3 recovery rules. His physical condition improves only through actual recovery, medical intervention, special abilities, or other resolved effects.

Singer possesses the Lightbearer ability **Heal Believer**, but only the first four Lightbearer abilities are directly learned/available for intentional use despite his higher Lightbearer rank. Heal Believer may also surface reflexively or unconsciously under circumstances established in play.

The local Background Count severely interferes with magical and related healing attempts.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-008 — Sensory Baseline

## Sensory Baseline

Before Singer's vision is restored, the cave is primarily experienced through touch, hearing, scent, taste, internal instrumentation, astral perception when used, and temperature.

Singer's smell and taste are unusually capable. Obvious odors and tastes are not vague atmospheric impressions to him; they can provide detailed separations between blood, chemicals, mineral water, living bodies, contamination, and other nearby sources.

Once his visual systems are restored, his natural and augmented vision includes hyperspectral perception beyond normal human or elven ranges, including additional orange, yellow, indigo, violet, near-ultraviolet, and near-infrared sensitivity.

The darkness therefore does not remain visually simple once his systems are functioning.

---

## HD-SUPPORT-009 — Campaign Framing

## Campaign Framing

The central uncertainty is not whether Singer is capable.

It is whether the world he remembers is the world around him.

Singer comes from a parallel version of 2064. The campaign world is Shadowrun 2051. He does not begin knowing that difference.

Familiar mechanics, peoples, technologies, magical principles, places, and history may overlap enough to encourage assumptions. Names, events, people, organizations, and outcomes may differ.

Treat Singer's remembered information as genuine knowledge of his own history, not automatically as correct information about the current campaign world.

Glaze presents the opposite displacement: she is native to the world but absent from it for an immense span of time. Singer knows a modern world that may not be this one; Glaze knows an ancient world that no longer exists.

The cave begins with both of them possessing enormous competence and incomplete context.

That is the introduction.

## HD-ARCH08-005 — REALITY / HISTORY

# REALITY / HISTORY
Singer originates from a genuine **2064 parallel history**, not conventional time travel. GM truth: the campaign world is a critically branched parallel reality, the crossing is not intended to become a solvable riddle, and Singer does not know this explanation. He treats 2051 as real evidence but has accepted no final cosmological explanation.

His strongest established discrepancy: in his 2064 history **Schwartzkopf manifested at Furth im Wald / Schwarzkoppe Mountain on May 21, 2051 and proclaimed sovereignty**. Contemporary records in this world contain no such event despite dense surrounding documentation.

## HD-ARCH08-006 — ORIGIN — ARRIVAL AND CAVE

# ORIGIN — ARRIVAL AND CAVE
Singer arrived in a sealed cavity beneath the **Mt. Baker / Kulshan** region after escaping a lethal attack in his own 2064 world. At arrival he was severely wounded, at Deadly Stun and near unconsciousness, blind from overloaded visual systems, wearing only white boxer briefs, carrying his tightly packed military rucksack, accompanied by bits of medical-tank debris. His medical and nanite systems stabilized and rebuilt him over time; his visual systems required deliberate subsystem-by-subsystem recovery.

The cave held sleeping Glaze in full dragon form — a cramped natural cavity, not a constructed lair or treasure hall. The local hostile background count was hostile at arrival; Singer **Cleansed it to zero**, which materially changed the cave's astral accessibility and later helped modern investigators examine it. He used Shape Earth to create a narrow passage and private chamber and helped open the way to the surface.

**First meeting anchor.** Their relationship did not begin with Singer demonstrating dominance or utility. Glaze first encountered him nearly dead, blind except through other senses and astral perception, displaced, emotionally exposed, grieving his wife and child — and still concerned with whether he could do anything for **her**. He called her beautiful and an angel and thanked her specifically for being there rather than for aiding him. As he recovered he gave her information rather than ownership, treated her choices as hers, shared tools, money and knowledge without demanding obedience, preserved her dignity while she learned, did not exploit her ignorance of the modern world, and allowed her to see vulnerability he concealed publicly. This is the causal foundation of her later trust and attraction.

## HD-ARCH08-009 — GLAZE — MODERN KNOWLEDGE STATE

# GLAZE — MODERN KNOWLEDGE STATE
Culturally displaced, not intellectually or socially primitive. Ancient, regal, socially sophisticated and extremely skilled; her modern gaps are informational. High Intelligence lets her infer rapidly from learned foundations but does not supply unstated modern facts.

Working understanding or direct experience of: electricity, batteries, communications and electronic computation; software, pilots, smart frames and the tool/mind distinction; Matrix concepts and digital information; datajacks, rigging and simsense conceptually; electronic identity, credsticks, digital verification and records; modern mass media, advertising, propaganda, social media and engineered framing; modern universities and reconstructed magical scholarship; satellites, global logistics, containerization and population scale; policing and security as institutional systems; corporate sovereignty and AAA megacorporations; FAB and magical-security choke points conceptually; hotels, locks, HVAC, bathrooms, showers, cleaning conventions, beds, restaurants and service culture; public transit and road vehicles; nightlife, clubs, fashion signaling and social subcultures; SIN/SINless exclusion; organlegging, corpse markets, ghouls and distinctions among predatory and nonpredatory infected; common metatype prejudice; Seattle geography sufficient to orient by waterfront and landmarks.

Firsthand experience: lodge culture, border entry, hotels, shopping, Belltown streets, a nightclub, restaurants, police presence, public EMS, ferries and skimmers, modern urban crowds.

She can make ordinary purchases and orders, navigate simple public situations, ask for clarification, handle common tasks in English, orient from waterfront landmarks, use modern lodging and routine urban systems, and recognize when she lacks context and ask targeted questions. ## HD-ARCH08-010 — English

## English
Functional English is better than her rating may sound because of very high Intelligence, linguistic mastery, strong memory and intense immersion. She independently handles ordinary public conversation, ordering, purchases, navigation, short negotiations, questions and jokes, and still prefers Sperethiel or telepathy for highly precise concepts. Her spoken English carries an unusual mixed **Irish/Gaelic/Nordic** sound — Sperethiel's musicality does not map cleanly — and the accent is already fading.

Singer has taught her that telepathy does not cross telephone, radio, Matrix or electronic-message channels by itself; that written languages can be machine-translated but ambiguity and error remain real; that a pocket secretary translates speech in near-real time and handsets do the same with a small delay.

Recent instruction covered Seattle **Cityspeak** and mixed street slang; scientific jargon as both legitimate compression and manipulative framing; the dihydrogen-monoxide and pickle demonstrations; English's Germanic base with Norse, French, Latin and Greek layers; why English became a trade language through historical power and infrastructure rather than linguistic superiority; and counter-propaganda overlays separating observed content from Singer's assessment. Singer told her his grandfather learned thirteen languages before twenty-five well enough to survive wartime interaction with soldiers, partisans, civilians and police, while his grandmother taught him three English words a day. Glaze took from that that fluency does not require erasing origin or accent.

The relationship is deeply trusting for its short age, companionate and intellectually intimate, physically comfortable and openly affectionate, sexually intimate, mutually protective, playful without being constantly jokey, increasingly organized around shared logistics, nonhierarchical, and compatible with strong individual autonomy. No automatic exclusivity, ownership, command relationship or permanent label beyond what has been established. Glaze's long prior celibacy matters: choosing Singer was a meaningful departure, not an inability to understand sex or affection.

Historically Glaze was logical, stoic, an arbitrator, low in aggressive ambition, celibate, and accustomed to detachment across immense time. She is now increasingly willing to seek companionship despite impermanence, pursue personal wants, take sides, act directly against genuine evil, and allow attachment without treating detachment as wiser. She remains ancient, regal, dangerous, direct, independent and capable of disagreement.

Singer's vulnerability, in Glaze's framing: **not simply that he cares too much, but that others can try to define what must be protected.** His moral distinctions are clear to her — professional criminality is not predation; consent matters; unnecessary harm matters; exploitation of vulnerable people matters; organlegging provokes unusually strong hostility. He is cynical about institutional incentives but not nihilistic.

Unresolved: fertility, pregnancy and biological compatibility; the long-term form of the relationship; what "home" becomes.

## HD-ARCH08-017 — TAETZAL — CONSOLIDATED DOSSIER

# TAETZAL — CONSOLIDATED DOSSIER
The **Taetzal building, Redmond** is the serious shared-property candidate.

**Structure and site.** Large *festung*-style structure, roughly 70 m square footprint, massive concrete lower construction and upper glass. Central-block site with a walled interior green area, smaller buildings to either side, a parking garage about a block away, and a taller observation-capable building roughly a kilometer out. Vehicle and garage access suitable for multiple vehicles. Much of the interior remains structurally intact but major computing and removable facilities were stripped and sold. Most of the building is securely locked and dark. A Yakuza-sponsored motorcycle repair business operates on part of the first floor.

**Ownership and contamination.** **New Horizons Development** owns it and is in bankruptcy, actively trying to dispose of it. Nominal value may be effectively 0¥ because of environmental liability. Roughly 6,000 m² of contaminated water sits under the facility. EPA/environmental enforcement attention is established. Singer's sensors detected dangerous industrial-solvent vapor in and near the deeper structure — he suspected TCA/TCE and warned the bike shop to ventilate if they notice the sweet ether-like odor. Records and news also indicated elevated **1,4-dioxane**; the exact chemical inventory is not confirmed in play.

**Current-world history (GM truth).** Aztechnology abandoned the property after the **Perfekto Polymers** disaster and **Maria Mercurial**-related events. **Shigeda-gumi**/Yakuza interests suffered badly over the deal and a boss was killed. Toxic-waste discovery turned the property into a Superfund-scale liability. New Horizons had Yakuza sponsorship in the deal's history. Successor gumi interest, pride, debt or grievance is currently unknown.

**Divergence from Singer's 2064 history.** Researching Taetzal, Singer found a history recognizably derived from what he remembers but missing his own interventions: Maria Mercurial was rescued; Yakuza violence occurred; New Horizons entered bankruptcy; Aztechnology's publicity damage was mitigated differently; **Texmacharch** was murdered; a dragon sighting exists; a dead ork shaman was killed by unseen assassins. The broad sequence resembles his original history but the connective outcomes are wrong — no clean property transfer to him, no controlled pollution publicity, no creation of his old corporate structure. In his version he had acquired Taetzal by February 2051, spent roughly a month repeatedly cleaning the contaminated tanks with the same general cleaning magic he used for water in Glaze's cave, and developed the site for medical and security business — retaining computers, storing trucks, using a rooftop helicopter pad, rebuilding upper-floor living space, and recruiting a naga and a basilisk formerly used as guards. He described the feeling as **divergent / jamais vu**. Glaze's framing: his memories are **comparison, not prophecy**.

**Glaze's decision.** She gave a clear **yes** to pursuing it, provided contamination can be controlled, title and liability are manageable, and the structure is sound. Her reasons are present-world utility: privacy, vehicle space, security, and enough room to exist in larger forms. She does not want it because Singer owned it in another reality.

**Singer's position.** Opening intended offer is **0.0¥**, on the logic that assuming the environmental liability is itself the consideration. Even if they reject it as a home, magical cleanup then resale could generate substantial value, but he explicitly values Glaze's time and choice over speculative profit.

**May 27 negotiation — Anne Mercer and Martin Keene.** Singer had a substantive call as Doctor James Taylor, CFO, Blue Mountain Holdings with New Horizons property contact **Anne Mercer** and outside property counsel **Martin Keene**. He was candid that Blue Mountain does not yet exist and would be formed as a wholly owned isolated subsidiary if the acquisition proceeds; that he had reviewed EPA/Superfund material and may assume the environmental burden; and that he has no acquisition capital beyond remediation infrastructure. Mercer and Keene accepted that a nominal-consideration transfer may be realistic because Taetzal is a liability rather than an asset. Learned:
- they need evidence the acquiring entity is not an empty shell;
- transfer costs, title, taxes and indemnification remain;
- parcel, primary structure and subsurface estate transfer together, but utility easements, tenant access rights and old recorded agreements survive;
- a retained below-grade service/storage access covenant names a **dissolved holding company** as beneficiary; New Horizons could not obtain release, and a successor beneficiary could assert those rights;
- **Riku's tenancy predates New Horizons**, and an old lease abstract may share predecessor language with the covenant;
- Mercer sent the title/covenant package;
- New Horizons maintenance independently confirmed abnormal odor in a first-floor service corridor and is documenting it before deciding on outside environmental response;
- a creditor representative or secondary stakeholder may want to speak after a nonbinding expression of interest shows seriousness.

Singer explained his interest began through Riku's shop and a VCR-adapted electric scooter, then an instrument and lab-safety observation of an ether-like odor combined with the EPA record. He emphasized he had performed no formal inspection and only advised renters to ventilate; Mercer and Keene accepted that as informal observation rather than free consulting. He told Mercer part of his interest is technical — he wants to test a new method for desolvating 1,4-dioxane and other pollutants. He offered availability next week and local Seattle meetings. No EOI has been sent in play.

**Yakuza lineage lead.** Dillon's parallel history work stays deliberately separated from the property negotiation. Best current lead is **Kobayashi-gumi**, because two independent lines place former **Shigeda-kai** people there, and one surviving local former Shigeda commercial-property figure appears against an old holding company resembling a possible covenant beneficiary. Dillon has not approached him. **This is lineage, not proof of inherited rights.** Singer intends to ask New Horizons for the actual beneficiary information in the morning rather than look too eager.

**Motorcycle shop.** Tomas introduced Singer and Glaze to **Riku**, a mechanic at the first-floor shop, with **Ken** as backup contact. Singer tested a cheap electric courier motorcycle with RCI/rigging interface, basic Pilot, functioning balance and gyro systems, an old but healthy battery pack, and practical courier history rather than luxury styling. Riku quoted roughly 16,500¥, or 15,800¥ as-is without stripping components. Singer did not reserve it and accepts it may sell; he expects about 16,000¥ cash would make later negotiation meaningful, and prefers inconspicuous transport to driving the Westwind into rougher Redmond. Singer and Riku exchanged codes, Ken is backup, and Singer offered a finder-fee path if their property lead produces a deal.

## HD-ARCH08-020 — May 25 — organleggers, Lone Star, Mount Baker

**Darnell Washington.** Singer and Glaze interrupted a professional organlegging abduction of the ork **Darnell Washington**: a four-person fake-medical pickup team, Darnell drugged with a fast-onset capture cocktail under an adhesive patch, selected specifically for tissue, the team working from structured pickup packets. He injected fragmented intelligence into Lone Star, police and tip channels while retaining observation opportunities. This is an active organizational pressure source, not a solved encounter.

Singer and Glaze consulted the established **Great Mountain Spirit / Old Man of the Mountain**, which reported multiple astral visitors, one notably competent initiated and Masked magician examining the deepest former sleeping area, a small physical group with tools including one Awakened member, and an artificial astral watcher left near the approach. Singer asked it to remove the watcher and close the entrance, then paid it karma and freed it from service. ## HD-ARCH08-021 — May 26 — Redmond, Taetzal discovery, the Rake

## May 26 — Redmond, Taetzal discovery, the Rake
**Morning after.** Comfortable rather than awkward: showering, joking about the sheets and used packets, continued affectionate exploration with clear consent. Glaze explained that her hybrid form has transformed support and load-bearing anatomy, that scales are armor-like, and that scale beds and horn roots are more sensitive.

**Redmond tour.** Singer and Glaze traveled from Belltown to Touristville and deeper Redmond, first by ordinary service and then with **Tomas**, a **Beermakers**-sponsored cab driver. Singer wanted a real local tour rather than protection — current gangs, leadership, operators, shops, survival patterns, and possible backup property with room for trucks — and Tomas provided local context rather than muscle. Glaze actively questioned him and built her own model of Redmond: reduced state and corporate presence does not mean nobody watches, and local or private eyes matter more; a good private base is often a place where watchers **do not care**, not a place nobody sees; quiet ownership can mean working utilities, no obvious squatting, deliveries that are not taxed, and neighbors who mind their business; the shadow economy functions as infrastructure for people excluded from official infrastructure; hardship and ruins are consequences, not singular causes; a poor neighborhood can still be someone's kingdom; doing nothing is also policy, because costs accumulate through hospitals, violence, theft, lost labor, children, later policing and further damage.

Singer discussed **Tamanous**/organlegger economics, Yakuza and Triad movement, Aztechnology's hidden property footprints, low drone coverage, and Redmond's social history. Tomas stayed knowledgeable but bounded to his local patch. They passed **Hangbokhan Nongjang** farm operations near the border area; Singer recalled old rumors of Triad/Seoulpa ties and Tomas treated those as old, uncertain rumors. Glaze was more interested in people making exhausted urban land productive again.

**Identity scaffolding.** Singer spent Matrix time constructing the James Taylor infrastructure and explained to Glaze that a professional manufacturer must create a vast corroborating life, not merely a card. He also taught her the limits of telepathy over technological communication and how automated translation works, and said they should eventually get a medical checkup for Glaze once they identify a trustworthy doctor.

**The Rake.** Nightclub continuity: **Hand Over Fist**, street name **the Rake**, central Downtown Seattle; fixer **Dillon Harmon / Tax Man**. Glaze previously led the key identity-business discussion while Singer supplied difficult English terms rather than taking over. Dillon's practical lessons to Glaze: a fixer sells trust, access, information, people, gear, work, disposal and sometimes safe places; network quality and reliability matter more than knowing everyone; bad clients panic, conceal the real problem, or assume paying the fixer means owning him.

After business Singer deliberately stopped being the social engine and let Glaze lead the evening — she chose where to dance, who to talk with, and when to move, and he followed and supported without teaching or directing. He joined the DJs in the booth for one song, beginning in deep bass, transitioning through mid-tenor and harmonizing against an existing staccato soprano line, astrally projecting the love-song emotion directly toward Glaze; astrally sensitive people nearby felt chills and the shadows deepened with the pulses. The DJs mixed him cleanly through the transition and fade. **Practical consequence: people present may remember the performance and some may recognize Singer later**, though he is not pursuing a career.

They danced and talked until the club closed at 01:00. Glaze characterized clubs as temporary tribes organized around rhythm, with alcohol as a secondary organizing principle.

**Return drive.** Singer thanked and tipped staff, cheered the DJs, and arranged the Westwind. The return was deliberately a drive rather than the shortest route — south on I-5 toward Tacoma at sustained high speed, then back by coastal roads and streets under spirit Concealment — about 1 hour 15 minutes, reaching the Le Quai garage at 02:15.

## HD-ARCH08-022 — May 27 — Glaze leads the day

## May 27 — Glaze leads the day
**Morning.** Singer let Glaze choose the agenda. She independently handled hotel housekeeping and breakfast in English and chose the **Space Needle**, followed by somewhere ordinary people go when not trying to sell, teach, employ, arrest or impress anyone. She made a 13:20 restaurant reservation herself. Singer repeatedly used vase-themed songs to tease her while they walked, and at the Needle explained its sentimental importance as an iconic part of the skyline he grew up with rather than simply the best view. He used his portacam and eye-optics skill to take strong photos and video of Glaze posing; she learned to move naturally while photographed and enjoyed being a tourist rather than merely studied.

**Space Needle / AR / visibility.** At the observation deck Singer showed her Seattle's geography including the hotel, waterfront, Redmond and the gray Taetzal block. A rented AR headset let her see labeled places and gave her a first taste of the layered visual-information environment Singer normally lives inside. He modified the rental AR presentation playfully with path markers and animated teacups, and explained that future smart goggles would let her experience a fraction of his normal visual-data lifestyle. Glaze understood more clearly why his overloaded visual systems left him effectively blind when they met: his vision is partly an information-organizing system, not merely eyesight.

Singer's agents searched for recent public images of Glaze and suppressed clean indexed copies where practical. One local image had already been copied into a **private user archive** before the public source disappeared; the agents flagged it and Singer did not intrude. No paparazzi organization or active threat is established from this. He explained paparazzi as commercially motivated photographers and how fame creates persistent unwanted observation; Glaze suspects she would dislike them unless the photographs were good.

**Restaurant economics.** The Needle meal was deliberately expensive for location and view. It mattered because Singer explained restaurant economics, tipping, taxes, service-worker pay, and the distinction between official gratuity and direct certified-credit payment. Server **Julienne** received a deliberately poor 10% official gratuity while Singer transferred the larger amount directly and told her to share properly; she agreed. She is not presently a durable contact. Singer's joking about large meals led to discussion of **The Big Rhino**, where he warned Glaze they might encounter metatype prejudice.

**Carnival.** They walked the waterfront carnival arm-in-arm. Singer won far too many skill-game prizes for too little effort until booth operators began refusing him service; Glaze found the soft exclusion hilarious and claimed an especially ugly fluorescent prize. He tied multiple stuffed animals around her and gave unwanted prizes to nearby children and passers-by. They rode the larger rides until novelty ran out; Glaze was as interested in why people voluntarily pay to scream, and in the social ritual around rides, as in the acceleration. Singer told her that despite appearing socially easy he is normally introverted off work; Glaze distinguished talking easily from needing strangers or noise and recognized he becomes quieter when nothing needs doing.

**AR data economy.** Singer gave practical instruction using her cheap AR goggles and handset: voice interaction, querying objects, reading ads, and recognizing the information trail left by attention and purchasing behavior. He framed the advertisement-funded model as misleading because the user is also the product. Glaze's key insight: an old merchant could watch what someone touched, while modern systems watch what someone **considered touching**, remember it, and learn what changes behavior. She still wants the technology but prefers systems that lie to the observer. Singer restyled her goggles under the Fashion ruling.

**Time / visibility / family support.** Singer told Glaze that without her he could easily work nearly all day across electronic, physical, social, Matrix and magical tasks, sometimes while lying in bed, because there is never enough time — and that she deserves his time and he would rather give it to her than feed that endless struggle. He also explained that before her he rarely traveled without layered concealment: disguise, magical Mask or Invisible effects, spirit Concealment, computer obscuration, camera destruction or drone hijacking. Recently he has hidden far less, because if Glaze is not hidden he does not want to be hidden either. Glaze valued the choice but told him not to confuse standing beside her with owing the world his face; if he hides tomorrow because hiding is wise she will not treat it as stepping away from her. She recognized the deeper meaning as Singer having spent a long time preventing anyone from assembling the whole of him while gradually letting her see the pieces.

Singer clarified that supporting Glaze means **like family** — if she does not work, he will; he is not presently ambitious about money for its own sake, but for her would "move mountains, even if slowly." Glaze accepted the model. She does not believe either must prove they deserve food by earning money, but does not want a desire to work dismissed because she does not need the income. She wants something that is **hers**: teaching, magic eventually, languages sooner, enchanting once she understands the market, consultation. She dislikes a modern employer automatically owning her mornings.

**Housing economics.** Singer taught her how security rating, entertainment, comfort, space, location, transit and schools affect cost, and distinguished expensive A/B/AAA areas — where residents partly buy surrounding infrastructure and security — from Z zones, where fortifying one building cannot repair a neighborhood and meaningful improvement requires broad infrastructure investment. He compared an expensive **Queen Anne** family home (roughly 3.7 million¥ sale, 37,000¥ monthly wealthy-family lifestyle) with a shared lower-cost household across the block (roughly 6,500¥ monthly, one primary renter plus three housemates at lower individual lifestyle benefit). Glaze understood shared households as pooling costly infrastructure.

**Racism / Night of Rage / metatype presentation.** Singer taught practical slurs and etiquette — never casually call orks or trolls **trog/troglodyte**; use the actual metatype or simply person — and explained **dandelion eater** for elves and **breeder** for humans, then stereotypes, goblinization fear, racial riots and the **Night of Rage**. Glaze's takeaway was not that Seattle is free of prejudice, but that ordinary mixed life — orks, trolls, humans and elves sharing work, transport and food without conflict — is more meaningful because the history exists. Singer briefly Physical-Masked both of them as lanky brightly dressed ork youths, rode the Metro two stops, fare-hopped while others did the same, and used Cityspeak and metatype mannerisms to demonstrate **being ordinary rather than invisible**. Glaze paid her own fare because she had explicitly wanted to, and understood that rules, enforcement and consequences are distinct things.

**The Big Rhino.** Below the building at **First Avenue and Seneca Street**, marked by a neon rhino; ork/troll-oriented in architecture and portions rather than merely admitting large metatypes to human-scale furniture. Singer ordered the **Ethiopian 64**, a 64-ounce medium-rare beef meal, and later a half Peruvian chicken and a **MAXIMUM PORK** sandwich. Glaze liked several sauces, especially horseradish despite calling it an attack. Singer was obviously familiar with the restaurant's food, sauces and customs but **nobody recognized him**, consistent with his former habit of visiting under concealment.

A large troll showed real anti-elf prejudice and told Singer to "frag off, fairy." Singer answered with a wager and an arm wrestle, won without theatrics, and then let the troll off the promised meal payment. The troll remained prejudiced but gained reluctant personal respect. He is **not a contact**. Singer and Glaze then joined the Rhino's rough karaoke pit, where shoulder-thumps, stolen tokens, spilled beer and light punches were socially ritualized rather than serious fighting. Glaze learned that karaoke works because everyone is allowed to be loud together, not because everyone sings well. They traded songs until the room filled and voluntarily gave up seats to newcomers. Glaze enjoyed the Rhino and said she would do it again.

**VR / Hell Wing 5.** After the Grackle meeting Singer had Glaze use the room's conventional VR goggles and gloves and entered the forest-glade space with her; the gloves give mild haptic cues and the headset directional audio. He stopped her from physically walking into the bed and taught her to move virtually while keeping her meat body still. In Sperethiel he taught that virtual movement need not be scalar — walking is an interface metaphor and an icon can simply appear at the next gate. Glaze rapidly began organizing virtual space as information rather than geography and described **architecture as grammar and movement as punctuation**.

He then took her to the dragon-oriented high-end VR/simsense game **Hell Wing 5**, created accounts through his Matrix capabilities, and let her use tutorial and sandbox mode. Glaze immediately recognized the dragon biomechanics as unrealistic, learned to treat game rules as their own system, and enjoyed exploiting impossible flight physics. She was disappointed virtual cattle had no taste through goggles and gloves.

Singer explained trodes as limited five-sense simsense dull enough not to injure a normal user, while stating he wants to verify safety for Glaze before she uses them; trodes would let her think movement rather than use gloves, though ordinary systems remain slower than his high-end neural response. He demonstrated the difference by entering a **64-dragon competitive brawl** against top-ranked players: motion fluid and unwasted, attacks missing him by millimeters, his committed attacks not missing. The game booted him for an abnormal response profile. Singer posted **"Guess a Fairlight gets you banned"**, deliberately claiming a roughly 2-million-nuyen top-commercial system rather than revealing that his comparable cyberware installation cost about eight times as much. Other players found the hardware explanation easier to accept than cheating.

Glaze now understands that VR immersion leaves the physical body vulnerable in a way comparable to astral projection; Singer explained countermeasures — spirit guard service, condition-based alerts and standing orders, or a tactical computer continuing to watch physical senses. She is interested in trodes eventually, after safety is established.

**End of night.** After VR they returned fully to the hotel room, became intimate, and settled to sleep.

## HD-ARCH09-005 — Infinite Warehouse / Tesseract Discussion

## Infinite Warehouse / Tesseract Discussion

Singer and Glaze discussed their respective forms of impossible storage.

Singer demonstrated his **Infinite Warehouse** ability. He opened a narrow line in space, approximately three feet, placed a pillow through it, retrieved the pillow, and then opened a larger threshold into a gray, featureless “non-space.” He stood partly inside the opening while discussing it.

Singer explained several practical observations about the ability:

- The storage is transient rather than a fixed mundane room.
- He had previously cleared it because carrying stored material seemed to affect or distort his astral form in ways he did not want.
- He believes the destination is metaplanar or otherwise outside ordinary physical space.
- He learned or developed the storage ability after another ability, **Astral Shift**, associated with an old ork swordsman friend who left Singer certain abilities.
- Organic material does not rot while stored. Singer has stored food and eaten it approximately a week later without noticing spoilage or a change in taste.
- Singer has never deliberately placed a living being inside the Warehouse.
- He worries that abandoning someone inside might kill them in a way analogous to some astral or metaplanar hazards, though he does not believe the storage automatically sterilizes living material.

Glaze’s storage was contrasted with Singer’s. Her small copper-scale pouch contains a stable tesseract capable of storing a substantial amount of material. Singer observed that Glaze’s foci remain magically connected and bonded while inside her pouch. By contrast, Singer suspects his Infinite Warehouse may separate a focus from its owner, interfere with the bond, or possibly de-bond it. This remained untested. Glaze was unwilling to risk one of her bonded foci merely to answer the question.

The distinction became important: Glaze’s pouch is an ancient stable magical storage object but is **not** itself automatically categorized as a modern focus, while Singer’s Warehouse is an ability whose metaphysical behavior may be different.

## HD-ARCH09-006 — Astral Shift Discussion

## Astral Shift Discussion

Singer described his **Astral Shift** ability from personal experience.

He said he can remain in the shifted astral mode for approximately fifteen minutes before pain becomes severe enough to force the issue. He described his practical travel speed as roughly **1,300 km/h**. He can bring other people through with him, but they share the injury risk of the transition.

Singer said ordinary people he has rescued or transported this way have often suffered minor to moderate vascular injury. Singer himself tolerates it much better because of his unusual resilience and body.

Singer speculated that Astral Shift may explain how he escaped death and appeared in Glaze’s sealed mountain lair. He suggested he might have been drawn toward the pooled mana or magical concentration around her location. Glaze did not accept that as established fact. Attraction, resonance, accident, or another unknown mechanism all remained possible explanations.

The discussion also established that ordinary astral travel is much faster than Singer’s stated Astral Shift speed. Glaze did not regard her foci as what makes ordinary astral movement faster; ordinary astral movement depends on the magician’s own magical nature/ability. Singer’s gray threshold and Warehouse do not behave like ordinary astral projection.

Singer said he had spent or sacrificed some of his magical potential on augmentations and had spent more on a precise/fast-motion ability that improved smaller-scale coordination, motion, and multitasking. Singer suggested that without those investments he might have been closer to Glaze’s magical scale if her focus were excluded from the comparison.

Singer also clarified that he can shift other people with him. Glaze’s practical reaction was that such a power makes sense for escaping death or bypassing overwhelming opposition—such as avoiding one hundred guards—not for saving a few minutes of ordinary travel time.

Singer paid the **¥2,000**.

Singer told the expediter to tell him if external pressure or action became necessary; Singer said he had done “pushing” before.

Singer also expressed appreciation for the expediter’s effort and connections and offered dinner after the work was completed, without pressure, as a way to build a professional network.

A Negotiation test was rolled during this interaction using Singer’s Negotiation 9 at TN 2. The roll was narratively successful with a very high success count. One displayed die was incorrectly shown as an unexpanded natural 6, which violated the campaign’s standing “all natural 6s explode” display rule. The narrative result—strong positive reception—remains valid, but the displayed die list should not be preserved as a correct mechanical record.

The expediter responded warmly/professionally:

- He would scrub the documents Monday night.
- He would push them first thing Tuesday morning.
- He would keep his own eyes on the filing.
- Dinner after completion was acceptable.
- Singer should **not** externally push yet; the expediter would specify if and when outside pressure would actually help.

At session end, **Blue Mountain Holdings was not yet declared legally formed**. The filing was in expedited preparation and expected to move Tuesday morning if no substantive objection appeared.

## HD-ARCH09-045 — FACE ROLE DISCUSSION

# FACE ROLE DISCUSSION

Glaze asked whether Singer had acquired “another person by dinner,” referring to the expediter/network-building pattern.

Singer explained the Shadowrunner **Face** role to her.

Singer’s description included:

- High charisma/social capability.
- Contacts and negotiations.
- Surveillance and counterintelligence.
- Stealth.
- Broad knowledge.
- Managing people, trust, access, information, and social position.
- Teams without a strong Face often suffer because technical or combat competence does not automatically solve human access problems.

Singer told Glaze she would make a very good Face.

Glaze’s interpretation was that a Face manages people in a way analogous to how Singer manages systems: information, positioning, trust, access, misdirection, timing, surveillance, and counterintelligence.

Glaze agreed that she would likely be very good at the role but identified her weakness as **modern context**, especially rapidly changing customs, jargon, references, and jokes.

Singer said he could teach the parts that change quickly, while much of the rest—social inference, power, negotiation, reading people—was already within her existing competence.

## HD-ARCH09-049 — Singer’s Library Matrix Run — User-Declared Results

## Singer’s Library Matrix Run — User-Declared Results

Singer allowed Mara and Glaze to continue exploring the library while he sat in one of the data-terminal booths.

Outwardly, Singer looked immersed in the terminal.

In reality, he connected a cable to a nearby junction and accessed the library host directly.

The user established the host as:

- Well provisioned.
- Generally soft at the outer/public levels.
- Harder in the deeper sections corresponding to digital stacks.
- Orange-level security was not expected, but even the deeper section was soft enough for Singer to end the run as a validated administrative user.

Singer searched for **dragon-related material**.

He downloaded approximately **2,300 MP** of dragon material after removing fiction and obvious noise.

The user specifically declared an **11-success Browse result** on records involving:

- Unique dragons.
- Dragon images.
- Names.
- Alternate names.
- Related records useful for identification/cross-reference.

Singer then used the **interlibrary system** to access university systems and dig further.

By the time his tally became significant, he had gathered the information he wanted from **six major universities with top-notch dragon research departments**.

The final archive remained approximately **2,300 MP** in total.

The material was not “paydata” in the conventional shadow-market sense. It was valuable as written academic/library information and as a research corpus for later use.

The collected archive should be understood as a broad dragon research library containing public/academic records, images, names, alternate names, sightings, genealogical claims, scholarly arguments, and cross-institutional material, scrubbed of obvious fiction.

The run was user-declared and should not be retroactively re-rolled.

## HD-ARCH09-051 — DINNER WITH MARA VELEZ

# DINNER WITH MARA VELEZ

As the library approached closing, Singer let Mara and Glaze continue the tour and conversation without constantly interrupting.

Singer asked whether they should go eat and told Mara that if she knew a good nearby place, Singer and Glaze would pay.

Mara chose a nearby late-serving casual restaurant, described as having noodles, grilled fish, dumplings, and a late-shift clientele. It was not fancy but was good and would stay open long enough for dinner.

Singer followed behind Glaze on the walk, watching for problems.

The streets were active but thinning. No immediate threat materialized. The route remained lit and reasonably public.

At the restaurant, Mara ordered for the table after Singer gave permission.

The meal included things such as:

- Dumplings.
- Grilled fish.
- A spicy noodle dish.
- Pickled vegetables.
- Broth.
- A fried dish Mara joked was better if they did not ask too many questions first.

The dinner conversation focused on books, libraries, archives, social use of public institutions, and what survives digitization.

Mara explained that libraries are used for much more than books, including:

- Schoolwork.
- Job searches.
- Legal forms.
- Cheap Matrix access.
- Research.
- Shelter from bad weather.
- Meetings.
- Simply having somewhere to exist without being required to buy something.

Glaze observed that this might be more important than the books themselves.

Mara joked that Glaze should not tell the acquisitions department that she agreed.

Singer commented on the **Transformer craze of the 2020s and 2030s**, saying it had flooded the book market with regurgitated material until Browse utilities began filtering much of it out, which contributed to books from that period receiving a bad reputation.

Singer said he had lived at times with dozens of bookshelves and appreciated libraries, adding that nobody could take away his “license to a paper book.”

Mara responded that he therefore understood why librarians still fought for physical shelf space.

Singer largely let Mara and Glaze talk through dinner.

At the end, Singer paid and thanked Mara by name.

Singer said:

> “See you around!”

Mara replied that he probably would, especially if Glaze kept asking good questions, and joked that Singer should bring Glaze back before she decided the library’s cataloging system was a personal insult.

Glaze answered:

> “No promises.”

After Mara left, Glaze said:

> “I like libraries.”

Then:

> “And librarians.”

Singer replied that librarians were a strange breed: often introverts until they discovered they had chosen a job that forced constant interaction with people.

Glaze agreed in substance, observing that people who chose books for solitude then spent all day being asked where everything was, and that competent librarians seemed unable to resist a good question.

## HD-ARCH09-083 — RULES / GM RULINGS / CORRECTIONS MADE DURING THIS SESSION

# RULES / GM RULINGS / CORRECTIONS MADE DURING THIS SESSION

## HD-ARCH09-084 — Rule of Six Display

## Rule of Six Display

The GM reiterated that **every natural 6 always expands**.

When dice are displayed, show the **final accumulated die values only**, not the intermediate sixes.

For meaningful rolls, show:

- Dice pool.
- Target number.
- Final accumulated die values.
- Success count.

A natural 6 left visibly unexpanded is an error.

## HD-ARCH09-085 — Naming Rule

## Naming Rule

Standing future NPC naming rule added:

Use plausible common-use real-world names appropriate to background, ethnicity, location, or social class. Avoid conspicuously fantasy/roleplaying-style names, over-themed names, or names designed mainly to communicate archetype. Handles may remain stylized when the setting supports them.

## HD-ARCH09-086 — Scene Pacing Rule

## Scene Pacing Rule

The narrator must move the world and secondary characters forward without requiring Singer to prompt every beat.

Glaze should choose directions, raise topics, initiate interactions, notice opportunities, and act according to her own knowledge and goals.

NPCs, institutions, and active plot clocks should also move naturally.

Routine transitions should not repeatedly stop with “what does Singer do?” unless there is an actual player decision.

Low-stakes walking, eating, commuting, shopping, casual affection, and repeated conversational microbeats should be compressed unless they create:

- New information.
- A decision.
- A consequence.
- A meaningful relationship change.
- A threat.
- An opportunity.
- A resource change.
- A genuine character-development beat.

The GM explicitly identified this session as having too much roleplay minutia and essentially zero action/plot advancement.

## HD-ARCH09-087 — Downtown Seattle Architecture Correction

## Downtown Seattle Architecture Correction

Do not default to quaint/old surviving central-downtown buildings.

Downtown has been heavily reshaped by disasters/rebuilding and should read as a modern cyberpunk city core.

Harrow & Finch specifically is in a modern ten-story building near Seneca & 4th beside the library, not an old historic building.

## HD-ARCH09-088 — Arcology Public Entry

## Arcology Public Entry

Public/commercial Arcology access does not automatically require ID presentation from every visitor.

Restricted/security-sensitive areas can still impose access controls.

## HD-ARCH09-089 — Purchasing / Availability Clarification Referenced During Session Close Discussions

## Purchasing / Availability Clarification Referenced During Session Close Discussions

A previously pinned campaign purchasing principle was reiterated around session close discussion:

Do not stack multiple availability/base-time delays for a purchase by default. Generally use the **longest applicable base time**. If one option has high TN/low base time and another has low TN/high base time, then a roll or more detailed adjudication may be needed.

This was not used to resolve a major purchase in the played session but was identified as an important standing rule to preserve.

## HD-ARCH09-090 — Weather Convention

## Weather Convention

Use the same calendar date in **1994** as the analogue for **2051 Seattle weather** when the GM asks for weather, unless overridden.
